ok_black_lemonade_wall.blurb: Black Lemonade wall is a small boulder wall in the Mount Scott part of the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge in southwest Oklahoma, a short stroll up from the road and just south of the twin-roofed Paperboy Millionaire boulder. Ten problems are recorded, from very easy lines through a few V2s up to V5, so there is something for a mixed group. The granite here forms shelves, alcoves and overhangs. An overhanging offwidth project sits near the road and there is an unclimbed face, so plenty remains undeveloped. It suits a quick session combined with the neighbouring Mount Scott boulders.

ok_island_boulders.blurb: Island Boulders is a compact cluster of granite blocks inside Great Plains State Park in southwest Oklahoma, nearly surrounded by lake water. All ten problems are bouldering, spanning V1 to V7, with most sitting around V2, plus a couple of hard lines at the top end. Landings are mostly flat, though the ones close to the water can be affected when the level is high. The approach is very short, so it is an easy stop if you are camping or passing through, and the rock is good quality. The park also has a bigger granite boulder field elsewhere, and a lot of this zone remains undeveloped.
ok_island_boulders.parking_note: Leave the car in the lot beside the boat launch; the boulders are a very short walk from there.

ok_thunderdome_wall.blurb: Thunderdome Wall is the main face of The Meadows area in the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge, southwest of the Lake Quanah Parker dam parking and just south of Little Baldy. It offers a rare mix for the refuge: roughly equal numbers of sport and trad routes, one top rope and a single boulder problem. Lines run from easy 5.6 through the 5.10s to a few at 5.11, so beginners and strong climbers both have options. The Meadows tends to get sun early and shade later in the day, and can feel stuffy when it is hot. Everything is climbed clean.
ok_thunderdome_wall.parking_note: Use the parking area at the Lake Quanah Parker dam; the wall lies southwest of that lot.
